title: Claim refusal names a revision-reopened dependency and its sanctioned escapes
action: Friction row 618: a NEEDS_REVISION judge verdict reopens a cell to status open (handlers_meta.rs:264-291); a dependent repair cell then refuses to claim on unmet deps (deps_all_capped_is_empty, read.rs:198) with a generic message, and nothing tells the orchestrator the sanctioned road — the pattern reads as a permanent deadlock. Fix (visibility only, NO law change — deps still require capped, nothing becomes claimable-through): where the claim refusal for unmet deps is rendered (follow the real refusal site from deps_all_capped_is_empty's consumers — read.rs is a hypothesis), when an unmet dep is open AND carries a NEEDS_REVISION judge verdict on its record, the refusal names that dep, quotes the verdict kind, and states both sanctioned roads: (a) claim and re-cap the reopened dep itself first, or (b) cells update the dependent's deps with a recorded reason. Deps unmet for ordinary reasons keep today's message byte-identical. TDD red-first: fixture dep reopened via the real judge-record path -> claim of dependent refuses with the verdict named + both roads (red today: generic text); ordinary unmet dep message byte-identical; claim-next skip behavior unchanged.

truths: a claim refused over a revision-reopened dep names the dep, the verdict, and both sanctioned roads
ordinary unmet-dep refusals are byte-identical to today
no dependency law changes — capped is still required

artifacts.substantive: refusal enrichment plus tests (or the real refusal site, named in the trace)

trace.outcome: claim refusal over a revision-reopened dep names the dep, quotes NEEDS_REVISION, states both sanctioned roads; ordinary unmet-dep text byte-identical; new CLI-driven integration suite
deviations: real refusal site is handlers_write.rs claimCell closure, not read.rs (read.rs only filters ready/claim-next); tests live in a new tests/revision_deadlock_visibility.rs binary because the CLI handlers root off current_dir
